name: Ceiling fan
description: A common way to circulate air in living and sleeping spaces.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one fan used for 8 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Fan type, size, and speed setting affect the appliance rating.

name: Standing fan
description: A portable fan that can be moved to the room where it is needed.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one fan used for 8 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Check the label for your fan and selected speed.

name: Air conditioner
description: A room cooling appliance; its power use depends on capacity, settings, and operating conditions.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one unit used for 6 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Rated input and actual energy use vary; use manufacturer information for your model.

name: Rice cooker
description: An electric cooker used for preparing rice and keeping it warm.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one hour of use per day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Cooking and keep-warm modes may use different power.

name: Refrigerator
description: A household appliance that cycles on and off to maintain its internal temperature.
usageExample: Use manufacturer energy-use information; rated input is not continuous 24-hour use.
usageNotes: Illustrative rated input only. This wattage does not describe the refrigerator's daily energy use.

name: Electric kettle
description: A kettle used for boiling water for tea, cooking, and other household needs.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: about 18 minutes of total use per day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Check the label; use time is usually shorter than a full day.

name: Microwave
description: A kitchen appliance used for heating or cooking food.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: 30 minutes of total use per day.
usageNotes: Illustrative input-power example only. Cooking output and electrical input are not the same rating.

name: Television
description: A television for watching programmes, films, and other media.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one television used for 4 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Screen size, display type, and settings change the rating.

name: Desktop computer
description: A desktop computer, typically used with a separate display and accessories.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one computer used for 5 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Actual power varies by components and workload.

name: Laptop
description: A portable computer often used for study, work, and entertainment.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one laptop used for 6 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Check the adapter or manufacturer's specifications.

name: Washing machine
description: A household appliance for washing clothes in cycles.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one hour of operation per day averaged over a month.
usageNotes: Illustrative input-power example only. A cycle's energy depends on the programme and water heating.

name: Electric iron
description: A household appliance used to press clothes.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one hour of use per day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. It cycles while heating; check the rating plate on your iron.

name: Water pump
description: A pump used in some homes to move water to a storage tank or supply.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one hour of operation per day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Pump type and capacity affect power; check your model's rating.

name: LED bulb
description: An electric light source commonly used in household rooms.
usageExample: Illustrative scenario: one bulb used for 5 hours a day.
usageNotes: Illustrative example only. Check the bulb packaging or product label for its wattage.
